in_sanskrit.name: Nirupa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lifting the darkness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nirupa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Nirupa originates from the Sanskrit language and translates to 'lifting the darkness'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the goddess Durga, who is revered for her power to dispel ignorance and bring light into the world. The name Nirupa symbolizes courage, wisdom, and compassion, as well as the ability to overcome adversity and bring about positive change.
